_about: Things you can carry. They show in your pockets on the People screen, and conversations and big days can check for them ('has') or give and take them.

items.name: Mum's note
items.text: Folded twice. For Mr Ambrose. You're not supposed to read it.

items.name: A carved wooden bird
items.text: Small, smooth, carefully made. It came with a note signed only "C."

items.name: A note signed "C."
items.text: "For the new one. Your father would want you to know he thinks of you."

items.name: A letter from your father
items.text: Opened. You've read it so many times the folds are soft.

items.name: A small brass key
items.text: From Gran's envelope, with your name on it.

items.name: Mrs Pell's photo
items.text: A boy on a bicycle, squinting into the sun. Daniel.
